**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post asks whether "the election" was rigged against the "rightful winner," a question form rather than an assertion. The closest thematic overlap is [T4-004524](#T4-004524), which reports that mainstream media were "saying the election is rigged" after a Comey/Weiner development, sharing the "rigged election" framing but attributing the claim to media coverage rather than posing it as a question. Other retrieved posts touch adjacent election-integrity and legitimacy themes without using the rigged framing: [T4-005214](#T4-005214) alleges counting of "illegals & other election fraud" behind a popular-vote margin claim, and [T4-004672](#T4-004672) asserts "The polls are FAKE!" citing Wikileaks, while [T4-005393](#T4-005393) mocks confusion over blame for a "#Hacked election" and [T4-003959](#T4-003959) merely asks who will win. None of these identify a "rightful winner" or otherwise match the new post's specific premise, so similarities are topical and weak rather than shared wording or narrative.
